patterns: APPSC repeatedly asks seismic zone of a place: Delhi = Zone IV, Visakhapatnam = Zone II, AP = Zones II-III, Kutch/North-East = Zone V, least active = Zone II.
Basic terms: epicentre has maximum intensity, seismology definition, seismograph as instrument, earthquakes cannot be predicted.
Statement traps on focus vs epicentre ('epicentre directly below the focus' is wrong) and causes of tremors (meteor impacts).
Occasional world facts: 1960 Chile M 9.5, Japan most earthquake-prone.
App MCQs add volcano types, intrusive landforms, 2025-26 seismic-code saga and recent quakes, deeper than APPSC's single-fact pattern.
